bio.name: Fajar Yuda Pratama
bio.headline: Software Developer & Electrical Engineer — Web, SCADA & IoT System Integration
bio.summary: Software developer and electrical engineer with 6 years of experience delivering web applications, SCADA/PLC automation, and IoT systems across logistics, manufacturing, utilities, and wellness industries. Combines full-stack development (Go, TypeScript, React.js, Node.js) with industrial system integration (Emerson, Siemens, ISA-101 HMI design). Recent highlights include building the integrated weighbridge transaction platform for Perum BULOG and unifying dual SCADA systems at Wilmar palm oil mills.

highlights: Active member of the robotics team; advanced to the national round of KRSBI Beroda (Indonesian Wheeled Soccer Robot Contest) after qualifying at the regional level
Took on part-time work throughout college as a computer technician, programmer, and electrical technician
Interned at an IoT solutions company as a full-stack developer and electronics technician
Active member of the school computer lab, assisting the lab technician with computer maintenance to support ongoing classes
Assisted in the administration of the Computer-Based National Exam (UNBK) in grade 11
Completed an internship as a computer and printer service technician
Completed an internship as a network technician, working with Cisco and MikroTik equipment

experience.description: System integration company — develop PLC and SCADA programs tailored to customer requirements, and perform troubleshooting on installed PLC and SCADA systems.
highlights: Delivered industrial automation and digitalization projects for enterprise clients including Wilmar Group and Perum BULOG
Developed customized PLC and SCADA programs to customer specifications, and diagnosed and resolved faults on deployed PLC and SCADA systems
Built highly customized software solutions tailored to specific industrial needs
Built software as a product for industrial use cases

experience.description: Engaged as a freelance full-stack developer to build highly customized software solutions for the company's transportation and lodging business units.
highlights: Built end-to-end management systems for a public transportation company and its lodging business unit, digitizing ticketing, manifests, finance, and property operations

experience.description: Engaged as a full-stack developer to resolve emergency production bugs and deliver new, highly customized features for client projects.
highlights: Developed web platforms for US utility fielding operations — field data collection, work management, and quality control used by hundreds of field workers and office staff

experience.role: Full-Stack Software Developer & Microcontroller Device Engineer
experience.description: Spa and reflexology chain — engaged as a freelance full-stack developer to digitalize branch operations, build custom IoT service-timer hardware, and structure the backend server infrastructure.
highlights: Digitalized spa operations end-to-end — POS, multi-branch management system, member mobile app, and custom IoT service timers — across dozens of branches

portfolio_list.name: Integrated Weighbridge Transaction Management System for Perum BULOG

public.summary: Weighbridge transaction platform for Perum BULOG that unifies vehicle weighing, quality control, loading/unloading, and reporting — integrated directly with scale hardware and CCTV license-plate OCR.
impact: Cut manual data-entry time per truck by integrating weighbridge scale hardware, CCTV with OCR license-plate recognition, and MQTT into a single Go + Vue.js platform
Reduced weighing and recording errors through automated validation across registration, QC, loading, and unloading workflows
Delivered real-time analytics and automated reports used daily by weighbridge operators and managers

portfolio_list.name: Palm Kernel Crushing (PKC) Automation System at Wilmar Pontianak Palm Oil Mill

public.summary: PLC & SCADA automation for the Palm Kernel Crushing plant at Wilmar Pontianak palm oil mill, with HMI screens designed to the ISA-101 standard.
impact: Automated the Palm Kernel Crushing process end-to-end with Emerson RX3i PLC and Movicon NExT SCADA, cutting manual intervention and unplanned downtime
Designed HMI screens compliant with ISA-101 (ANSI/ISA-101.01-2015), improving operator situational awareness and reducing operator errors
Integrated conveyors, press machines, and hammer mills across multiple production lines via Modbus TCP/IP with real-time interlock protection

portfolio_list.name: Integrated Management System for Spa & Reflexology

public.summary: Multi-outlet spa & reflexology management platform covering booking, cashier, therapist scheduling, inventory, finance, and analytics in one system.
impact: Consolidated booking, cashier, therapist scheduling, inventory, and finance for multi-outlet spa businesses into one Express.js + React.js platform
Improved customer retention through built-in membership, voucher, and loyalty programs
Gave owners real-time revenue and performance analytics across branches, replacing manual spreadsheet reporting

portfolio_list.name: Unified SCADA System Integration at Wilmar Pelintung Palm Oil Mill

public.summary: Migration and unification of two separate SCADA systems (Wonderware InTouch and Siemens WinCC) into a single WinCC platform at Wilmar Pelintung palm oil mill.
impact: Unified the fractionation SCADA (Wonderware InTouch) and refinery SCADA (Siemens WinCC) into one WinCC platform, giving operators centralized control of the entire production process
Migrated and rebuilt fractionation process screens and tags into the refinery's WinCC platform, validating control behavior against the running plant
Reduced system complexity and duplicated engineering, improving coordination between fractionation and refinery operations

portfolio_list.name: Work Management Application for Power Pole Maintenance

public.summary: Field operations management system for power pole maintenance: project assignment, GPS-enabled task tracking, and geographic coverage analytics for project managers and fielders.
impact: Sped up crew assignment with a map-based view showing each fielder's working area and current workload (React.js + ArcGIS API)
Improved on-time task completion through real-time progress tracking and GPS-enabled location services for field crews
Gave project managers a single calendar and dashboard view over all fielding requests

portfolio_list.name: Integrated Public Transportation Company Management Application

public.summary: End-to-end management platform for a public transit company: ticketing, seat booking, departure manifests, driver commissions, payroll, and financial reporting.
impact: Digitized ticketing, seat booking, manifests, payroll, and finance for a public transportation company (Node.js + React.js + MySQL)
Cut manifest preparation time by automating profit, additional cost, and driver commission calculations per departure
Gave management per-departure profit & loss visibility, replacing manual bookkeeping

public.summary: Property management system covering the full guest lifecycle — reservation, check-in/checkout, receipts, pricing packages, rooms, and role-based access.
impact: Digitized the full guest lifecycle — reservation, check-in/checkout, receipts, pricing packages, and rooms — for the company's lodging business unit
Automated branded receipt printing and booking records, eliminating daily manual paperwork
Provided occupancy and revenue insight that informs pricing-package decisions

portfolio_list.name: Integrated Job and Employee Management System with Job Tracking and Quality Control (QC)

public.summary: Workforce and quality management platform combining job tracking from request to billing with employee administration: attendance, overtime, leave, and QC workflows.
impact: Streamlined job tracking from request to billing across teams, reducing turnaround time
Automated attendance, overtime, and dual-level leave approval workflows, cutting manual HR administration
Reduced missed QC reviews with structured review states (new, ready for review, completed) and per-team daily reports

portfolio_list.name: Web-Based Electric Pole Data Collection Application with Geolocation Features

public.summary: Field data collection platform for utility infrastructure: electric pole inventory with geolocation, structured attribute forms, photo documentation, and project tracking.
impact: Enabled structured collection of electric pole records with precise geolocation via Google Maps integration
Reduced field data-entry errors with structured pole/anchor/riser/VGR forms and mandatory photo attachments
Gave managers live progress tracking across projects and fielding requests through a hierarchical project tree and tracker tables

portfolio_list.name: Mobile Member Application for Online Booking and Account Management at Radja Spa & Reflexology

public.summary: React Native member app for online booking, therapist selection, transaction history, loyalty points, and voucher redemption.
impact: Launched a React Native member app for online booking with branch, service, and therapist selection
Increased repeat bookings through in-app loyalty points, voucher redemption, and personalized therapist rebooking
Shifted bookings from phone and walk-in to self-service, reducing front-desk workload

portfolio_list.name: Development of IoT Timer Device for Service Optimization at Radja Spa & Reflexology

public.summary: Custom IoT timer device (NodeMCU, Arduino, MQTT) that synchronizes therapy session timing between treatment rooms and the POS in real time.
impact: Designed and deployed custom IoT timer devices (NodeMCU + onboard RTC) that synchronize session timing with the POS via MQTT and Socket.io in real time
Eliminated session over/under-run disputes and improved therapist utilization through precise, automated time tracking
Kept devices accurate through WiFi drops with onboard RTC timekeeping

portfolio_list.name: Integrated Point of Sale Application with IoT Timer for Radja Spa & Reflexology

public.summary: Point-of-sale system purpose-built for spa operations — booking, room/bed and therapist allocation, payments, and live IoT room-timer control from the cashier desk.
impact: Reduced checkout and booking handling time with a POS connected live to IoT room timers via MQTT and Socket.io
Managed daily transactions with real-time therapist schedules and room/bed availability in one screen
Cut booking conflicts through live availability visualization for therapists, rooms, and beds

portfolio_list.name: Integrated Management Application for Radja Spa & Reflexology

public.summary: Multi-branch back-office platform unifying finance, members, employees, inventory, vouchers, treatments, and reporting into one dashboard.
impact: Centralized finance, member, employee, inventory, and voucher management for all branches into one Node.js + React.js dashboard
Cut monthly reporting effort with automated cross-branch reports for transactions, expenses, cash flow, and member points
Brought expense approvals under central control, reducing unrecorded branch spending
